# UX review

A skill for the QA reviewer of tasks that change UI: it opens the pages the task changed in a real browser and checks them as a person would use them.

`skills/ux-review/SKILL.md` is Vibe Teamlead's own (AGPL-3.0-or-later). The checklists it reads are unmodified copies:

| File | Source | License |
|---|---|---|
| `skills/ux-review/reference/web-interface-guidelines.md` | [vercel-labs/web-interface-guidelines](https://github.com/vercel-labs/web-interface-guidelines) `command.md` at `434b7f91364665f2f733b310ec54809bf8f37937` | MIT, `licenses/web-interface-guidelines.LICENSE` |
| `skills/ux-review/reference/impeccable-audit.md` | [pbakaus/impeccable](https://github.com/pbakaus/impeccable) `.claude/skills/impeccable/reference/audit.md` at `613fbf88e0ef08709eaf238653285f430250c0ea` | Apache-2.0, `licenses/impeccable.LICENSE`, notices in `licenses/impeccable.NOTICE.md` |
| `skills/ux-review/reference/impeccable-harden.md` | [pbakaus/impeccable](https://github.com/pbakaus/impeccable) `.claude/skills/impeccable/reference/harden.md` at `613fbf88e0ef08709eaf238653285f430250c0ea` | Apache-2.0, as above |

The reference files mention commands of their own projects (`/impeccable …`); they are not installed here, and the skill tells the reviewer to use the files as checklists only.
